label: First Roar — whatever you intend
candidates: You can roar — and everyone who witnesses it will fear you, whatever you intend.
Roar. The earth shatters ahead of you, and everyone who sees it is frightened — even if your flame burns hope.
This is the roar. It frightens all who witness it, no matter what your flame carries.
You roar to shatter the ground — but know this: everyone within sight will fear you, regardless of your light.
The roar clears distance fast, but whoever witnesses the line takes fear — your flame's color cannot protect them.
Roar, and the stone breaks open — yet every soul who sees you do it learns fear, whether you mean them to or not.
You can roar a path through the earth. Everyone who watches will be pushed toward fear. Your intention does not matter.
This is roar: it splits the ground and makes witnesses afraid, even when your flame is green.
